name: Lean Context
description: Structured context assembly, transcript slimming, and per-turn token savings reports.

keepRecentMessages.label: Recent raw messages
keepRecentMessages.help: How many recent transcript messages stay verbatim in assembled context.

keepRecentTokens.label: Recent raw token budget
keepRecentTokens.help: Approximate token budget reserved for recent verbatim transcript history.

workingMemoryMinRecentTokens.label: Working-memory minimum raw tokens
workingMemoryMinRecentTokens.help: Smallest raw recent token window to retain once memory-first replay starts.

backgroundContextMaxTokens.label: Background context budget
backgroundContextMaxTokens.help: Maximum token budget for synthesized background knowledge from session, procedural, archive, and recall sources.

maxRecallResults.label: Recall results
maxRecallResults.help: Maximum recall snippets to include when memory search is available.

enableMemoryRecall.label: Enable recall
enableMemoryRecall.help: Search indexed memory/recall sources and attach a few relevant snippets.

autoCompactTriggerTokens.label: Auto compact threshold
autoCompactTriggerTokens.help: Approximate transcript token count that triggers proactive state compaction.

maxToolResultTokens.label: Tool result slimming threshold
maxToolResultTokens.help: Approximate tool-result token size that triggers transcript slimming before persistence.

persistLargeToolResults.label: Archive full tool results
persistLargeToolResults.help: Store original oversized tool results under the plugin state directory and leave a pointer in the slimmed transcript.

replyFooterEnabled.label: Reply footer
replyFooterEnabled.help: Append a concise saved-token footer to the next visible assistant reply after each turn.

replyFooterMaxCategories.label: Footer categories
replyFooterMaxCategories.help: How many top savings categories to mention in the per-reply footer.
